description: Watch a live frequency-bar visualizer from your microphone or any audio file.

faqs.a: Either: grant microphone access for a live input, or upload an audio file to visualize.
faqs.q: What can be the sound source?

faqs.a: An AnalyserNode computes real-time frequency data, drawn as animated bars on canvas.
Microphone audio is processed locally and never recorded or sent anywhere.

howto: Choose Microphone or Upload a file.
title: Audio Visualizer
